rule.binding: P33: Synth-fresh is bound by every row; ISM-fresh by the rows with has_room true. A quantity binds unless the PREREG fixes its range, the row's step lies outside the set's steps, or the value is outside PHYSICS.md's limits. Scans carry V only as V_formula_m3, a formula parameter. HARNESS-PLAN.md 8.2's second call: a row whose own histogram does not hold its truth (d_m < R_m, a synth generator defect, not the method's) does not bind d_m or d_minus_R_m; such a row keeps its place and every other field, with those two quantities null (corpus.histogram_holds_truth).

quantities.step_ms: time step of the histogram the method read
quantities.R_m: receiver ball radius (0 = the point receiver of scan 2 and 2b)
quantities.d_m: source to receiver centre (scans: t_arrival x 343.2)
quantities.gap_ms: first reflection after the direct sound: the synth gap, or (first-order image distance - d) / c in a box
quantities.t60_s: synth: T60 of k1; rooms: P5 design T60 at the row's band
quantities.t60_design_125_s: rooms: P5 design T60 at 125 Hz
quantities.drr_db: synth: 10 log10(Ed / S_rev) (exact); z3: image-source direct over reflected energy; scan 4: the weak direct's level (null when blocked)
quantities.late_share_db: late part's energy over the early part's, dB (critique parametrisation, scan_i4.py:20-23)
quantities.V_formula_m3: a scan's V: a parameter of the Sabine direct-energy formula, not a room
quantities.alpha_walls: absorption per face x0 x1 y0 y1 floor ceiling
quantities.rec_wall_m: receiver centre to the nearest face
quantities.particles: particles per source (SPPS cells, scan 3 and 5, noise_probe)
quantities.method: SPPS computation method (real rows; scan 5 (a) models energetic mode)
quantities.phase: scan 1 and ablate: where the arrival falls inside its step (fraction of a step)
quantities.d_grid_m: scan 1 and ablate: the grid distance the arrival came from (d_m is the arrival times 343.2)
quantities.level_after_direct_db: scan 1: 10 log10(S_rev / (Ed + S_rev)); below -8 dB the critique called a row ill-conditioned
quantities.frac: run length after the arrival over T60 (scan 2, 2b, ablate)
quantities.blocked: no direct sound reaches the receiver
quantities.method_half_width: the half_width the method was told, when it differs from the generator's R
quantities.long_run_within_5pct: scan 2b: the same response recorded to -150 dB gives an EDT within 5 % of the truth
quantities.c_case_m_s: z3: the case's speed of sound
quantities.m_case_np_per_m: z3: the case's air attenuation (energy, Np/m)
quantities.images: image sources in the z3 echo
quantities.gap_case_ms: z3: the judge's own first-reflection gap

receivers_checked.what: each report's position_m against cells.json's receivers

real_seeds_py_no_meta.what: results that change when the method is called as critique/real_seeds.py calls it (no meta) instead of with the report R/c; differing rows are scored both ways

runs.run_scans: final/run_scans.py:25-58, the frozen method's own scan 1: deduplicated, d >= 0.6 m, well-conditioned (level after the direct >= -8 dB); its tally is checked against scans_all.json
runs.scan_i12: the committed critique/scan_i12.py: deduplicated, d >= 0.6 m, ill-conditioned rows kept (reported apart there); checked row by row against its output, critique/scan_i12_R0.31.json
runs.early_run: the critique's first run of the grid, critique/scan_i12.json in target/: no d cutoff and no dedup, 6,240 rows; its script was not kept (the committed one adds both). Checked row by row against it: every grid value, and every truth at d >= 0.6 m; below 0.6 m its truth function, also not kept, differs, so those rows are scored against the committed synth.truth_edt and their first-run truth is shown beside

truth_not_held_to_output.why: the first run's truth function was not kept: below d 0.6 m, where the direct sound dominates, its truths differ from the committed synth.truth_edt (which scores these rows here), e.g. EDT 12.5 s for T60 0.3 s; at d >= 0.6 m every truth matches

forms.run_scans: final/run_scans.py:81-121: the method told half_width 0 for the point-receiver histogram; a row whose own long run is not within 5 % of the truth leaves the tally, as there (its tally is checked against scans_all.json)
forms.scan_i4b: the committed critique/scan_i4b.py: the method called as common.run_all calls it, with no meta, so it takes its default ball (0.31 m) for the point-receiver histogram; every row, the long-run filter counted

ablate.not_scored: its t1 golden rows: the t1 set
